title: Luck & Risk
supportedClaims: Luck and risk are opposite forces that often look identical in the final score.
A clean result tempts people to over-credit skill or over-blame failure even when randomness shaped the path just as much.
The reader is pushed to judge process more carefully, stay humble in praise, and stay humane in criticism because outcomes are noisier than they appear.
caution: Humility about luck should not become paralysis. Process still matters, even if process never controls every variable.
